theme: 3 terms on functions as values: the type of a function, a function that takes its arguments one at a time, and chaining functions into one

terms.definition: The type of a function, written with an arrow like `(Int) -> Int`, so you can store a function in a variable.
terms.example: Make the handler's Function Type `(String) -> Void`, not `Any`.

terms.definition: Turning a function with several parameters into a chain of functions that each take one argument and return the next function.
terms.example: With Currying, we set the tax rate once and reuse the function.

terms.definition: Joining two functions into a new one, where the output of the first becomes the input of the second.
terms.example: Use Function Composition to chain the price steps into one function.

video.title: Function Type, Currying & Function Composition | Day 62
video.description:
Learn to explain functions as values in Swift: Function Type, Currying & Function Composition, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Function Type - The type of a function, written with an arrow like `(Int) -> Int`, so you can store a function in a variable.
Currying - Turning a function with several parameters into a chain of functions that each take one argument and return the next function.
Function Composition - Joining two functions into a new one, where the output of the first becomes the input of the second.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 62 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: Swift Function Type, Currying & Function Composition | Day 62
landscape.description:
Explain Function Type, Currying & Function Composition in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
함수 타입, 커링, 함수 합성 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Function Type - The type of a function, written with an arrow like `(Int) -> Int`, so you can store a function in a variable.
한국어: 함수 타입: `(Int) -> Int`처럼 화살표로 쓰는 함수의 타입으로, 함수를 변수에 저장할 수 있게 함

Currying - Turning a function with several parameters into a chain of functions that each take one argument and return the next function.
한국어: 커링: 매개변수가 여러 개인 함수를 인자를 하나씩 받아 다음 함수를 돌려주는 함수들의 연결로 바꾸는 것

Function Composition - Joining two functions into a new one, where the output of the first becomes the input of the second.
한국어: 함수 합성: 두 함수를 이어 새 함수를 만들어, 첫 함수의 출력이 두 번째 함수의 입력이 되게 하는 것

In this video, Mina and Jake read a price pipeline: a function stored in a variable, a function that returns a function, and two steps chained into one, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

dialogue.title: Arrows everywhere

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, why does `discount` have an arrow in its type?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a Function Type. `discount` stores a function from `Int` to `Int`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's Currying. You pass the `rate` first and get back a new function.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not yet. Currying gives back a function that waits for the price.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, that's Function Composition. The output of one becomes the input of the next.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Minus five, then plus ten percent.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Function Type stores it, Currying fixes the rate, Function Composition chains them.
A Function Type lets you keep a function in a variable.
